AzureAd._comment: Placeholder scaffold values. Real values injected via App Service configuration (KV references) per platform-controlplane.bicep. Instance/TenantId/ClientId are non-empty here only so Microsoft.Identity.Web configuration binding succeeds at start-up; OIDC metadata is fetched lazily on first token validation, so placeholder values do NOT prevent the scaffold from booting or from serving GET /ping anonymously.

ManagedIdentity._comment: OPTIONAL. When set, the DefaultAzureCredential is pinned to this UAMI clientId. Required in deployed App Services with multiple identities attached (SDK cannot disambiguate); OMIT for local dev so the credential chain falls through to AzureCliCredential. Deployed value bound by platform-controlplane.bicep to the UAMI's clientId (see uami.bicep, task 028).

Cosmos._comment: L2 fleet-scoped state store (spaarke-provisioning/runs). Account is provisioned by cosmos-provisioning.bicep (task 024) in rg-spaarke-platform-{env}; disableLocalAuth is TRUE so RBAC data-plane access via the L2 App Service MI is the ONLY path (task 030 grants Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor). AccountEndpoint MUST be set — CosmosModule.AddCosmosModule fails fast at startup per NFR-05 if it is empty. DatabaseName + ContainerName default to the design-locked values; override only for isolated smoke-test containers.

ServiceBus._comment: L2 handler-dispatch queue (task 038). FullyQualifiedNamespace MUST be set — ServiceBusModule.AddServiceBusModule fails fast at startup per NFR-05 if it is empty. QueueName defaults to sprk-provisioning-jobs; override when targeting an isolated smoke-test queue. DefaultTimeToLive is the fallback when a handler-specific override under HandlerTimeToLive is not set. HandlerTimeToLive is a per-HandlerId map (e.g. {"H4":"01:00:00","H8":"00:15:00"}) — OMIT this section entirely when no overrides are needed (a stray non-TimeSpan value under HandlerTimeToLive would fail Options binding at startup). Credentials use DefaultAzureCredential (UAMI) — NEVER a connection string per ADR-028 MI-outbound rule; deployed L2 App Service picks up its UAMI via ManagedIdentity:ClientId above.
